title: Removal of floor slabs for storage.
officialText:
In buildings of noncombustible construction, floor slabs to an elevation of
not more than 25 feet (7620 mm) above the legally established curb level may be removed to provide temporary storage for
debris, provided that:
1. The stored debris is piled with sufficient uniformity to prevent lateral displacement of interior walls or columns as
determined by a registered design professional.
2. The height of the piled material will not burst the exterior walls due to horizontal loading as determined by a registered
design professional.
3. The operation does not otherwise endanger the stability of the structure.
